staticPreservedCategories.identification: Actual PhotoCaptureProfile and CaptureMinigameProfile types, not filename-only matching

restorePolicy: Audit performs no restore/delete. Preserve all original 54 gameplay save/photo files and preserve Unity Insights/Analytics across user time gap. If task TestResults.xml is narrowly restored to entry bytes, first archive and hash its exact final native XML in task QA, and recheck source/backup SHA before restoring. No font restoration currently needed if fontDifferences is empty. No blanket restore.
limitations: Audit is a point-in-time snapshot after final matrix and before any root-owned narrow native TestResults restoration.
Visual pass and Editor exit state are attributed to parent; native XML and tool-result JSON are independently read and hashed here.
phase: After final native matrix c62d20014e23; before any root-owned narrow TestResults restore

finalNativeMatrix.runtimeEditorExit: Parent reports stopped Bootstrap clean, isolation false, both save/photo path overrides null; this audit makes no Unity calls.
finalNativeMatrix.visualReview: Parent reports final six capture images visually pass after UI settle; this is not an independent image review by this audit.

missingLiveSummary.interpretation: Observed cache differences across the user time gap and Editor sessions; this audit cannot attribute each cache expiration to a specific actor. No cache restoration or deletion performed. Current Insights/Analytics preserved.
